launch.description: A verified release installs into /Applications and opens a native Nix Mac window.

steps.description: Launch the installed application
Wait for a native application window
args:
tell application "System Events"
repeat 60 times
if exists process "nixmac" then
tell process "nixmac"
if (count of windows) > 0 then return "nixmac window ready"
end tell
end if
delay 1
end repeat
error "nixmac did not open a window"
end tell

steps.description: Wait for the rendered onboarding screen
steps.name: nixmac-window

startup-recovery.description: Load the startup-recovery initial state, reconcile an interrupted onboarding completion, and show the missing-configuration repair view after hydration.

steps.description: Verify the intended pre-launch recovery state
args: ObjC.import('Foundation'); const stateDir = ObjC.unwrap($.NSHomeDirectory()) + '/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac/'; function readState(name) { return JSON.parse(ObjC.unwrap($.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(stateDir + name, $.NSUTF8StringEncoding, null))); } const onboarding = readState('onboarding-state.json'); const preferences = readState('global-preferences.json'); if (onboarding.completedAt !== null || onboarding.lastBuildAt !== 1751967600 || preferences.configDir !== '/tmp/nixmac-desktop-missing-config') throw new Error('startup-recovery requires its initial-state fixture'); 'nixmac recovery seed verified';

steps.description: Require the seeded missing configuration to have no flake
Launch Nix Mac with the seeded on-disk state
Wait for the hydrated repair view
steps.name: startup-recovery-window

steps.description: Verify the repair view identifies the supplied configuration path
steps.name: startup-recovery-path

steps.description: Verify Nix Mac persisted the recovered completion timestamp
args:
nixmac_state_dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac"
nixmac_completed=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract completedAt raw -o - "$nixmac_state_dir/onboarding-state.json")
/bin/test "$nixmac_completed" = 1751967600
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state_dir/onboarding-state.json" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-recovered-onboarding.json
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state_dir/global-preferences.json" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-loaded-preferences.json
/usr/bin/printf 'nixmac recovered completion: %s\n' "$nixmac_completed"

steps.description: Retain the app-written recovery state
steps.name: recovered-onboarding.json

steps.description: Retain the loaded preferences for reproduction
steps.name: loaded-preferences.json

steps.description: Check Nix installation
Check Homebrew installation
Launch Nix Mac
Inspect the rendered onboarding screen on the configured desktop
steps.name: package-tools-window

create-configuration.description: Create a configuration through native controls, verify its literal host and destination in the app-written flake and Git repository, then confirm they survive relaunch.

steps.description: Require the fresh onboarding JSON fixture
args: ObjC.import('Foundation'); const root=ObjC.unwrap($.NSHomeDirectory())+'/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac/'; function read(name){return JSON.parse(ObjC.unwrap($.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(root+name,$.NSUTF8StringEncoding,null)));} const preferences=read('global-preferences.json'); const onboarding=read('onboarding-state.json'); if(preferences.configDir!==null || preferences.repoRoot!==null || onboarding.completedAt!==null || onboarding.lastBuildAt!==null) throw new Error('create-configuration requires fresh-onboarding.initial-state.json'); 'nixmac fresh configuration seed verified';

steps.description: Require a new destination in the disposable guest
Launch the verified application

target.label:
First time here
Start from scratch New to nix-darwin? We'll generate a clean starter configuration tailored to this Mac.

steps.description: Verify the literal host, saved destination, committed flake and Git repository
args:
set -eu
nixmac_config=/Users/admin/nixmac-desktop-config
nixmac_state="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac/global-preferences.json"
test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract configDir raw -o - "$nixmac_state")" = "$nixmac_config"
test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract repoRoot raw -o - "$nixmac_state")" = "$nixmac_config"
test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract hostAttr raw -o - "$nixmac_state")" = desktop-test-mac
/usr/bin/grep -F 'darwinConfigurations."desktop-test-mac"' "$nixmac_config/flake.nix"
/usr/bin/grep -F 'networking.hostName = "desktop-test-mac"' "$nixmac_config/flake.nix"
test "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$nixmac_config" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree)" = true
/usr/bin/git -C "$nixmac_config" ls-files --error-unmatch flake.nix
/usr/bin/git -C "$nixmac_config" show HEAD:flake.nix > /tmp/nixmac-desktop-committed-flake.nix
/usr/bin/cmp /tmp/nixmac-desktop-committed-flake.nix "$nixmac_config/flake.nix"
/usr/bin/git -C "$nixmac_config" rev-parse HEAD > /tmp/nixmac-desktop-created-commit.txt
/bin/cp "$nixmac_config/flake.nix" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-created-flake.nix
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-created-preferences.json
/usr/bin/printf 'nixmac configuration and Git verified\n'

steps.description: Quit the tested app cleanly
Require process exit before restarting
args: for attempt in $(/usr/bin/seq 1 20); do if ! /usr/bin/pgrep -x nixmac >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; /bin/sleep 0.5; done; exit 1

steps.description: Relaunch the installed application
Verify app hydration preserved preferences and the created Git revision
args:
set -eu
nixmac_config=/Users/admin/nixmac-desktop-config
nixmac_state="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac/global-preferences.json"
test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract configDir raw -o - "$nixmac_state")" = "$nixmac_config"
test "$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract hostAttr raw -o - "$nixmac_state")" = desktop-test-mac
test "$(/usr/bin/git -C "$nixmac_config" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(/bin/cat /tmp/nixmac-desktop-created-commit.txt)"
/usr/bin/cmp /tmp/nixmac-desktop-created-flake.nix "$nixmac_config/flake.nix"
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-relaunched-preferences.json
/usr/bin/printf 'nixmac configuration survived relaunch\n'
